steps.title: Define modern layout goals for Modern Calculator
steps.description: Establish key aesthetic and ergonomic structures including clear display areas and round-cornered flat styled buttons.

steps.title: Create background shape resources for buttons
steps.description: Implement custom state selector drawables for numbers, operators, and action buttons to provide beautiful interactive hover states.

steps.title: Set up project metadata configuration
steps.description: Define the app package name com.moderncalculator.app and set compile configurations in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure standard build files
steps.description: Configure the build.gradle build system matching target SDK 34 and AGP 8.3.2 with strict Java 1.8 compatibility.

steps.title: Declare app permissions and activities in manifest
steps.description: Create the AndroidManifest.xml setup with a default system Light material theme.

steps.title: Construct activity layout xml file
steps.description: Code the user interface inside activity_main.xml with distinct colored visual elements and full weighting to support all screens.

steps.title: Implement mathematical evaluation parser algorithm
steps.description: Implement a solid Recursive Descent Parser directly inside MainActivity.java supporting precedence, brackets, and divide-by-zero checks.

steps.title: Handle user button click events
steps.description: Wire buttons to custom click handlers in Java 8 compatible anonymous inner classes to append expressions and trigger calculation.

steps.title: Add smart formatting and decimal validations
steps.description: Prevent duplicate decimals in individual number inputs and display results correctly formatted with zero-removal logic.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Perform comprehensive gradle builds and static checking steps to package and finalize the executable debug Android app package.
